purpose: Public source data-shape observations for benchmark relevance index design; not a runnable relevance index or performance evaluation.
scope: Current 9 evidence IDs, all 14 TMG metadata entries, 6 additional HF candidates from benchmark-source-plan; representative case schemas and result manifests. 49 HF official datasets discovered; not all reviewed.
limitations: No authenticated AA payload was fetched; AA field analysis uses public OpenAPI.
Gated DeepSWE/HLE/GPQA case payloads were not downloaded.
HF dataset info revisions and Dataset Viewer rows/statistics are independently observed live responses; they are not an atomic pinned snapshot.
Source schemas and sample rows were inspected; not every task or every model result was reviewed.
